name: @ling-stack/desktop
description: Ling Stack desktop shell with shared Web UI and Computer Use picture-in-picture.
author: Ling Stack contributors

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/web build && corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/daemon build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild preload/main-window.ts preload/computer-use-preview.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outdir=dist/preload --out-extension:.js=.cjs && esbuild ../../packages/daemon/dist/cli.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lingCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lingCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/daemon/cli.mjs && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/api-client build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && playwright test --config tests/playwright.renderer.config.mjs && playwright test tests/computer-use-preview-a11y.spec.mjs --workers=1 --reporter=line --output=test-results/computer-use-preview-a11y
scripts.test:renderer: vite build --config vite.config.ts && playwright test --config tests/playwright.renderer.config.mjs && playwright test tests/computer-use-preview-a11y.spec.mjs --workers=1 --reporter=line --output=test-results/computer-use-preview-a11y
scripts.test:renderer:a11y: vite build --config vite.config.ts && playwright test tests/computer-use-preview-a11y.spec.mjs --workers=1 --reporter=line --output=test-results/computer-use-preview-a11y
scripts.package:mac: corepack pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64
